responsibility: This is the central internal header for GNU D tree lowering. It defines D-specific language flags and accessors on GCC tree nodes, binding-level and label-tracking structures, frame-info node layout, intrinsic and scope enums, and declares the major cross-file entry points for declaration, type, expression, statement, runtime, import, module, intrinsic, and typeinfo lowering. It is the shared contract tying together nearly all `gcc/d` implementation files.
same_name_distinction: Unlike d-tree.def, which merely declares the extra D-specific tree codes, this header is the main shared internal interface for the D GCC frontend, defining tree/node metadata, internal structs and enums, and declarations for lowering and code-generation helpers across gcc/d.
